notes.title: Patch with Russian translation

tags.feature: This patch adds a full Russian translation and localization for Mesmer, our game about overthrowing a despot, in addition to the following changes:

tags.bug: Fixes to a "literal" ton of grammatical, punctuational, and spelling errors;
Fixed mission markers in some missions not pointing to the right location;
Fixed the “Sweet Child of Mine” -achievement, it should now trigger correctly.
